name: Force XPLR AXS rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed reference for the 13-speed, 1x, 46T-max Force E1 XPLR AXS rear derailleur, without battery. Full Mount reference for a UDH-compatible frame. SRAM’s XPLR methodology lists the battery separately.
